decisions.decision: Resist end-bent lateral load and overturning with soil reinforcement (tie-back straps) attached to the backwall and extending into the MSE fill.
decisions.basis: User decision for the backwall calculation. SDG 3.13.2.N.3 (January 2026) permits attachment only when total settlement of the soil above the cap bottom does not exceed 2 in; that geotechnical confirmation remains pending. Strap service/factored loads are reported per foot of backwall for a Specialty Engineer (SDM 12.3.F).

decisions.decision: Pedestrian live load only: no vehicular or maintenance-vehicle loading on the bridge, landing or backfill.
decisions.basis: User decision. Live-load surcharge is the 90 psf pedestrian load applied as a uniform surcharge (LRFD 3.11.6.1). Braking, wind on live load and HL-93 surcharge are not applicable.

decisions.decision: Use typical MSE fill parameters behind the end bents: φ = 30°, active Coulomb pressure with δ = 0, γ = 115 pcf.
decisions.basis: User decision. φ follows the SDG 3.13.2.I.1 sand backfill value; γ uses SDG Table 2.2-1 compacted soil, conservative against the 105 pcf MSE stability value. Replace with tested values if the reinforced backfill is specified.

decisions.decision: The 4-in MSE landing slab bears on the backwall top.
decisions.basis: User confirmation; the FreeCAD MSE slab thickness equals the 4-in backwall drop. Gravity design counts 50% of the slab dead and pedestrian load at the backwall centerline. Overturning and strap design take no stabilizing credit from the slab. Its weight on the fill is an earth surcharge.

decisions.decision: Include the cheek walls in the backwall calculation, with no retained fill: wind load only.
decisions.basis: User decision. Final cheek-wall geometry remains deferred under D-005.

decisions.decision: Design the backwall at its maximum height and locate the tie-back straps in the backwall near the overturning resultant, about 1.5 ft above the cap top, aligned with an MSE reinforcement level.
decisions.basis: User decisions. Current provisional FreeCAD crown height is 4.083 ft for both end bents. D-005 still defers final wall geometry; rerun the calculation when it is adopted. The strap elevation requires wall-vendor coordination.

signoff.note: Verification sign-offs for the lineage graph. Each entry is a recorded human statement: who checked a node or relation, when, and on what basis, pinned to the register SHA-256 hashes at that time. The generator marks an entry stale when the current hashes differ from the recorded ones. Nothing here is generated automatically. Entry shape: {"id": "<node id or source->target edge id>", "by": "name", "on": "YYYY-MM-DD", "basis": "what was checked", "hashes": {"node": "<sha256>"} for a node or {"source": "<sha256>", "target": "<sha256>"} for an edge}.
